🎥 Timeless Elegance in Killeen | 2-Story Home with $25K Buyer Incentives!

Step into timeless elegance with this exquisite 2-story home, nestled in the prestigious Heritage Oaks Subdivision of Killeen, Texas. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring high-end appliances, a double oven, stunning granite countertops, and sleek tile flooring.

Retreat to the serene lower-level master suite, complete with a spa-inspired bathroom and a grand walk-in closet. Upstairs, enjoy a second master suite—ideal for multi-generational living or hosting long-term guests—alongside spacious secondary bedrooms that offer both privacy and comfort.

Entertain effortlessly with a sophisticated formal dining room, an inviting living area, and a layout that flows beautifully throughout.

💰 $25,000 worth of Buyer Incentives – Pay for Closing Costs AND Buy Down the Rate!
